device_entry.name: B&K Precision 9100系列可编程直流电源
device_entry.name_en: B&K Precision 9100 Series Programmable DC Power Supply
tags: 电子器件供电与台架测试
device_entry.description: 这是一款台式可编程直流电源，可输出并调节稳定的直流电压与电流，用于电子器件供电、原型电路测试、实验室台架测量以及需要远程控制电源输出的自动化实验。
device_entry.description_en: This is a benchtop programmable DC power supply that provides regulated DC voltage and current. It is used for powering electronic devices, testing prototype circuits, bench measurements, and automated laboratory setups requiring remote control of power output.
